title: Volunteer
description: Want to give back to your community? You can share your talents in so many ways, such as gardening, working with kids & youth, feeding people in need, and more!

props.html:
VOLUNTEER

Get involved with the life of St. Paul’s!

Volunteers are the most important part of our church - they keep us alive and vibrant! Whether it’s working with kids, helping with weekly services, maintaining our grounds, or even offering to cook a meal for a family in need, there’s so many moving parts that help keep our church running! By volunteering at St. Paul’s, you help us continue to serve as a place of Worship, Refuge, and Outreach at home and abroad.

Below is a list of all the ways you can be involved at our church. Click on the + sign over the category you’re interested in for a full list of opportunities.

Contact the church office, or fill out the Contact Form at the bottom of the page to let us know what you want to be a part of!
